change: Separate native completion polling from periodic busy Herdr liveness observations; retain fresh readiness and identity checks at send and completion.

diagnostics.destination: Existing completion_terminal event payload.diagnostics and terminal decision diagnostics
diagnostics.scope: Successful observation of a native terminal outcome; unknown/faulted tasks do not synthesize a completion or complete metrics.

tradeoffs: Busy liveness checks are spaced one second after the previous check finishes. Ownership-loss detection during a working turn can therefore take longer than before.
Native completion polling retains 100 ms sleeps; actual latency also includes file IO and any in-flight Herdr request.
Fresh checks before a prompt, Claude terminal confirmation, and readiness before the next FIFO task remain required.
The 11-to-4 query comparison is a controlled four-second busy-state reproduction, not a production CPU percentage or end-to-end model speedup.
The real log samples predate this build. No real model tasks or global provider sessions were created during verification.
